messages:
Lina R: Heads-up — drafting a very short internal RN + pinned blurb for the micro-launch tomorrow. Need someone to trim to one paragraph for execs and confirm rollback lanes.
Sam K: happy to trim. can you drop the current draft here?
Lina R: Pasting a 3-line draft below. want it < 150 chars ideally.
Lina R: ```
Micro-launch: rolling out small serving fix (dispatcher backpressure) to reduce 95p tail latency by ~20%. No model changes. Canary 5% -> 25% -> 100% over 30m.
If regressions, roll back to tag v2026.03.12-hotfix within 10m.
```
Alex G: looks good. change 'No model changes' -> 'No model or config changes' so infra folks aren't surprised.
Maria P: For the pinned message: add link to RN PR and the deploybot cue. short form: "fix to dispatcher backpressure, canarying, rollback tag & standby"
Jordan T: I'll be on standby for the 30m window (EU morning). If we see elevated 5xx, we execute rollback.
Sam K: Edited draft, one para: "Rollout: small serving fix to dispatcher backpressure to reduce tail latency (~20% at p95). Canarying 5%→25%→100% over 30m. No model or config changes. If errors increase, rollback to v2026.03.12-hotfix (10m target). See PR: https://github.com/redwood/infer/pull/1234 and deploycue below."
Lina R: perfect. @DeployBot can you queue the canary schedule and pin the RN for internal channel at T-30?
DeployBot: queued canary schedule: 2026-03-12 14:00 UTC, steps [5%,25%,100%] with 10m checks. RN pin request sent to #eng-releases.
Alex G: Quick ops question — what does the rollback command look like? Pls paste the exact `deploy` command so oncall can run it fast.
Jordan T: rollback command: ```sh
redwood deploy --env=prod --tag=v2026.03.12-hotfix --force --reason="dispatcher-backpressure-regression"
```
Maria P: I'll pin Sam's one-paragraph RN and add the PR link. Also adding the standby roster: Jordan T (EU), Alex G (US-PST), Sam K (US-EST).
Lina R: Great. Also set a tiny comms blurb for customer-facing: "We performed a micro-update to improve latency; no action required." Maria, can you draft that after we finish internal pin?
Maria P: Draft for customer blurb: "We deployed a minor performance fix to reduce latency; customers should see improved responsiveness. No action required." keeping it short.
Sam K: all set. I've pushed the pinned blurb into the internal RN thread and added a short checklist: canary start, quick smoke at 5m, metrics check at 10m and 25m, escalate if error rate >0.5%.
Lina R: Thanks. Final checks: confirm deploybot cadence, pinned RN, rollback command posted, and standby roster. Anyone else want to be added?
Alex G: I'm available for rollback if needed.
DeployBot: pin confirmed in #eng-releases by Maria P, canary schedule confirmed.
Lina R: @here ok, we'll proceed. Rolling start at 2026-03-12 14:00 UTC. I'll post a one-line follow-up at start. :rocket:
Sam K: good luck, team :thumbsup:
